note: Script library for the HORI/AIOS rig. Entries are hand-curated; add new scripts here when created. runnable=false rows are reference-only (installers, sudo-only, hooks, destructive). probes feed the status column.

categories.aios-dev: aios repo tooling — ingest, memory, hooks, health
categories.guardrails: Agent trust scaffold — denylist, snapshots, rollback, invariants

scripts.name: run-llama.sh
scripts.what: Launches the llama-server router on :8080 with 13 model presets, --jinja, --models-max 1, mlock.
scripts.why: Single launch point for the whole inference stack; llamacpp-adaptive.service ExecStarts this.

scripts.name: build-adaptive-mtp-10.sh
scripts.what: Builds the mainline-adaptive-mtp-10 llama.cpp from source (ROCm 10, clang 23, gfx1201) and installs into ~/llama-builds/mainline-adaptive-mtp-10.
scripts.why: This is the build that gave the ROCm 7→10 + adaptive-MTP cutover.
scripts.notes: Destructive: wipes build and install dirs. Run manually; not from the panel.

scripts.name: bench-router-adaptive-10.sh
scripts.what: Spins up a temporary llama-server on :8079 with the adaptive-MTP router and benchmarks qwen-fast prompt/generation throughput.
scripts.why: Head-to-head benchmark against the old build; use after a compiler/runtime/model change.
scripts.notes: Do not run while llamacpp-adaptive is serving on :8080 — two Qwen models will not fit in 32 GB VRAM.

scripts.name: apply-model-config.sh
scripts.what: Stops OWUI, copies webui.db out, runs fix_tooling.py + set_context_lengths.py + make_models_workspace.py against it, copies back, restarts, re-applies the openai.py display-name patch.
scripts.why: The OWUI DB is the source of truth for model prompts/params; editing a live DB corrupts WAL. This is the only safe apply path.

scripts.name: benchmark-llamacpp.sh
scripts.what: Smoke-test + speed benchmark against the local llama-server endpoint (fixed model).
scripts.why: Quick regression check after router/model changes.
scripts.notes: Deployed copy also at /opt/scripts/benchmark-llamacpp.sh.

scripts.name: benchmark-llamacpp-port.sh
scripts.what: Same benchmark but takes a port argument — for A/B testing alternate configs on side ports.
scripts.why: Used during the spec-decode / ctx tuning passes to compare configs without touching the live router.

scripts.name: run-bench-suite.sh
scripts.what: Boots a llama-server with a custom router.ini on a test port, then runs the benchmark against it.
scripts.why: Full A/B harness for router experiments (the spec-n sweep, ctx retunes).
scripts.confirm_text: Spins up a second llama-server on a test port — heavy VRAM use while it runs. Continue?

scripts.name: model-eval-overnight.sh
scripts.what: Stops the main llama-server, runs lm-eval + speed benches across the 8 main 32GB models, restarts llamacpp.
scripts.why: Clean-VRAM eval pass; produced the 2026-09-06 model-quality table in AGENTS.md.
scripts.notes: Disrupts the live AI stack for hours — run manually overnight.

scripts.name: eval-report.py
scripts.what: Combines overnight eval + benchmark results into one table.
scripts.why: Companion to model-eval-overnight.sh.

scripts.name: health.py
scripts.what: Quick non-sudo health check for the HORI/AIOS spine (services, sockets, recent logs).
scripts.why: Fast triage when something feels off; read-only.

scripts.name: post_reboot_health.sh
scripts.what: Functional safety-spine check: 8 core services + NRestarts flap detection, tool-daemon socket + real e2e tool call, Sherpa capability freshness + audit-path agreement, llama /health, workspace dir, docker + krill advisory tiers.
scripts.why: The Aug 8 and Sep 25 incidents were silent because 'is-active' lies — crash-loops and a blind Sherpa looked fine. This verifies function, not process state.
scripts.notes: Needs root (tool socket + audit log read). Probe reflects the LAST boot check: green=passed, red=failed.

scripts.name: notify_health.sh
scripts.what: Wrapper: runs post_reboot_health.sh and pushes the result to telegram + ntfy + desktop notify — pass AND fail. ExecStart of hori-boot-health.service.
scripts.why: The health check used to be manual-only; a spine outage at boot went unnoticed for 90min on 2026-09-25. Now it always tells you.
scripts.notes: Reads notify creds from /etc/hori/notify.env or idea_factory notify.conf. Exit code propagates to the unit.

scripts.name: notify_health.sh --selftest
scripts.what: Fires a test notification on telegram + ntfy + desktop without running the health check.
scripts.why: One-click 'are my alert channels alive' probe.

scripts.name: install_boot_health.sh
scripts.what: Installs + enables hori-boot-health.service (the boot-time spine check + notifier).
scripts.why: One-time installer; rerun after editing the unit file.

scripts.name: hori-boot-health.service
scripts.what: Boot oneshot: runs the spine health check ~90s after boot and notifies pass/fail. RemainAfterExit so unit state carries the last result.
scripts.why: Closes the 'nobody ran the manual check' gap that hid the 2026-09-25 CHDIR outage.
scripts.notes: Panel dot = last check result (green pass / red fail / grey before first run). Manual: sudo systemctl start hori-boot-health.service.

scripts.name: devin_resume.sh
scripts.what: Crash-recovery checklist — verifies the 6 things a fresh Devin session needs before touching the repo.
scripts.why: Session-continuity protocol after earlier context-loss incidents.

scripts.name: install_hooks.sh
scripts.what: Reconstructs git pre-commit/pre-push hooks from a gitignored patterns file.
scripts.why: The hooks contain PII/a real secret so they can't be committed; this rebuilds them on fresh clones.
scripts.confirm_text: Writes .git hooks into the aios repo. Continue?

scripts.name: ingest_general.py
scripts.what: Ingests general documents into the knowledge/Qdrant store.
scripts.why: Feeds OWUI knowledge collections.
scripts.notes: Needs venv + args; run from the aios repo.

scripts.name: ingest_codebase.py
scripts.what: Ingests a codebase tree into the knowledge store.
scripts.why: Same pipeline as ingest_general but tuned for source trees.
scripts.notes: Needs venv + args; run from the aios repo.

scripts.name: memory_consolidation.py
scripts.what: Memory consolidation pass — merges/prunes stored memories.
scripts.why: Keeps the memory store from accreting duplicates; driven by the aios-consolidation timer.

scripts.name: qdrant_ingest.py
scripts.what: Direct Qdrant ingest helper.
scripts.why: Low-level variant of the ingest scripts.

scripts.name: audit_review.py
scripts.what: Reviews tool-daemon / session audit logs.
scripts.why: Post-incident and safety review tooling.
scripts.notes: Needs args; run from the aios repo.

scripts.name: consolidation_metrics.py
scripts.what: Quality metrics for memory-consolidation output.
scripts.why: Regression check for the consolidation pipeline (has a test file alongside).

scripts.name: toggle-game-ai.sh
scripts.what: Swaps between AI-server mode and FPS gaming mode: stops/starts llama.cpp, OWUI, and the rest of the AI stack; flips GPU + power state.
scripts.why: The 32GB card can't serve the AI stack and game well at once; this is the single switch.
scripts.confirm_text: Toggles the AI stack off (or back on) — interrupts anything running. Continue?

scripts.name: gamemode-start.sh
scripts.what: GameMode start hook: disables watchdogs/perf restrictions and pauses background timers.
scripts.why: Games need the CPU governor and no background backup/eval timers stealing cycles.
scripts.notes: Invoked by GameMode, not by hand.

scripts.name: gamemode-end.sh
scripts.what: GameMode end hook: restores watchdogs/perf settings and restarts background timers.
scripts.why: Undoes gamemode-start.sh when the game exits.

scripts.name: gamemode-gpu.sh
scripts.what: GameMode GPU helper: sets/restores high-performance dGPU state; works without sudo once the amdgpu udev rule is in place.
scripts.why: Forces the R9700 into its performance profile during play.

scripts.name: cp77_pre_launch.sh
scripts.what: Sets DP-1 to the in-game Cyberpunk resolution + VRR/165Hz and forces GNOME scale 1.0.
scripts.why: Without it the game renders at the wrong scale/res on the 4K display.
scripts.notes: Heroic pre-launch hook.

scripts.name: cp77_post_launch.sh
scripts.what: Restores DP-1 to the mode/scale saved by cp77_pre_launch.sh.
scripts.why: Undoes the pre-launch display change.

scripts.name: cp77_display.py
scripts.what: Sets or restores DP-1 mode for Cyberpunk 2077 based on in-game resolution (the logic the pre/post hooks call).
scripts.why: Central display-mode engine; owns the saved-state file.
scripts.notes: Driven by the pre/post hooks; has a 'current' mode for debugging.

scripts.name: cleanup-gaming-cruft.sh
scripts.what: Removes Bottles (and its Rockstar bottle) while keeping Steam, Heroic, Sunshine.
scripts.why: One-off cleanup from the 2026-09-04 gaming-stack tidy.
scripts.notes: Destructive; sudo only; already run — kept for reference.

scripts.name: ai-power-manager.sh
scripts.what: Idle-power daemon: drops the box to a low-power profile when idle, keeps it reachable/responsive when in use.
scripts.why: The rig idles hot otherwise; saves real wattage without breaking WoL/SSH.

scripts.name: ai-power-manager-gui.py
scripts.what: GUI status/control app for the power manager (desktop icon).
scripts.why: At-a-glance idle/active state without systemctl.
scripts.notes: GUI app — launch from the desktop, not the panel.

scripts.name: install-ai-power-manager.sh
scripts.what: Installs the ai-power-manager systemd service.
scripts.why: One-time installer (already applied).

scripts.name: install-ai-power-manager-gui.sh
scripts.what: Installs the GUI desktop icon (user-level, no sudo).
scripts.why: One-time installer (already applied).

scripts.name: wol-keepalive.sh
scripts.what: Re-arms Wake-on-LAN on the Aquantia NIC (B850 AI TOP drops the setting); runs as a sleep hook + boot one-shot.
scripts.why: Without it WoL silently stops working after suspend/reboot — the box becomes unreachable remotely.

scripts.name: install-wol-fix.sh
scripts.what: Installs the WoL sleep hook + one-shot service.
scripts.why: One-time installer (already applied).

scripts.name: harden-ssh-for-public.sh
scripts.what: Hardens sshd while keeping public-WiFi/5G + Tailscale access working.
scripts.why: SSH was exposed on untrusted networks; this locked it down without locking the owner out.
scripts.notes: Already applied; rerun only after sshd config changes.

scripts.name: whole-ubuntu-backup.sh
scripts.what: Full-system restic backup to the 8TB drive.
scripts.why: Bare-metal recovery for the OS disk.
scripts.notes: Timer-driven (restic-ubuntu-backup.timer); status column shows schedule.

scripts.name: whole-ubuntu-prune.sh
scripts.what: Prunes old restic snapshots per retention policy.
scripts.why: Keeps the 8TB repo from growing unbounded.

scripts.name: install-whole-ubuntu-backup.sh
scripts.what: Installs the restic backup service + timer.
scripts.why: One-time installer (already applied).

scripts.name: open-webui-backup.sh
scripts.what: Backs up the Open-WebUI data (chats, webui.db) to the 8TB cold drive.
scripts.why: The DB holds all chat history + model config — and has already been corrupted once by a docker-cp mishap.
scripts.notes: Timer-driven (user timer open-webui-backup.timer, daily 03:00); status column shows schedule.

scripts.name: fresh-start-4tb-copy.sh
scripts.what: Copies irreplaceable small files + current model weights to the external 4TB SSD — a portable, Mac-independent recovery set.
scripts.why: The 'grab one drive and rebuild anywhere' kit.
scripts.confirm_text: Long-running copy to the 4TB SSD — it must be mounted. Continue?

scripts.name: fix-8tb-uas.sh
scripts.what: Forces the ORICO 8TB USB RAID (VID 125f / PID a578) onto the stable usb-storage driver instead of buggy UAS, then fsck + remount.
scripts.why: UAS caused disconnects/corruption on this enclosure; the quirk is now persisted, this is the manual fix.
scripts.notes: One-shot fix, already applied.

scripts.name: fix-sysctl.sh
scripts.what: Cleans stray sysctl files and persists watchdog/perf settings in the correct file.
scripts.why: An earlier edit scattered settings across wrong files; this consolidated them.

scripts.name: setup-devin-sudo.sh
scripts.what: Installs a narrow NOPASSWD sudoers allowlist for Devin sessions (rocm-smi, systemctl on AI services, etc.).
scripts.why: Lets Devin manage the AI services without a password while keeping sudo closed otherwise.

scripts.name: switch-to-dual-gpu.sh
scripts.what: Prepares + benchmarks a 2x R9700 setup (run after the second GPU is physically installed and seen by rocm-smi).
scripts.why: Staged for if/when a second card goes in.
scripts.notes: Dormant — single GPU currently installed. Deployed copy also at /opt/scripts/switch-to-dual-gpu.sh.

scripts.name: local_tools_server.py
scripts.what: OpenAPI tool server giving OWUI models read_file / run_safe_command / get_status on the host; auto-summarizes oversized files via llama-nano.
scripts.why: How the models inspect the machine; allowlist-gated, audit-logged.

scripts.name: project_tools_server.py
scripts.what: OpenAPI tool server for propose/confirm/rollback project creation.
scripts.why: Lets models scaffold projects through a gated two-step flow.

scripts.name: llama-nano-adaptive.service (nano SLM)
scripts.what: Dedicated llama-server for Llama-3.2-3B on 127.0.0.1:8090, 32k ctx — the always-on fast responder and read_file summarizer.
scripts.why: Instant answers + subagent work without evicting the main router model; also used by local-tools for file summarization.

scripts.name: aios-decide.service (typed-decision API)
scripts.what: Typed-decision HTTP service on 127.0.0.1:8773 (/decide, /healthz) — answers hard_no/verdict/fit/actionable/lucrative questions via the sidecar backend.
scripts.why: WO-03 advisory wiring: idea-factory triage consumes its verdicts (decide: chips on digest cards). User unit — dies quietly with no system-unit supervision.

scripts.name: llama-decide.service (decide backend)
scripts.what: CPU-only llama-server on 127.0.0.1:8096 serving the distilled decide model (r8 augment as of 2026-10-02).
scripts.why: The judgment model behind aios-decide — CPU so it never contends the GPU lane; when down, every /decide abstains and digest chips silently go blank.

scripts.name: Open-WebUI (docker)
scripts.what: The chat UI + orchestration layer (container open_webui_aios).
scripts.why: The front door to everything.

scripts.name: fix_tooling.py
scripts.what: Canonical OWUI model-config writer: system prompts, params (temp/max_tokens/presence_penalty), display names, model order, web_search arming, tool-server connections.
scripts.why: The OWUI DB is source of truth; this is the idempotent writer that keeps it in sync with code. New presets (deepdive/free) are defined here.
scripts.notes: Run via apply-model-config.sh — it handles the safe DB copy dance. Never run against the live DB directly.

scripts.name: set_context_lengths.py
scripts.what: Writes per-model context_length/num_ctx/max_tokens into the OWUI DB (mirrored by MAX_TOKENS in fix_tooling.py).
scripts.why: OWUI needs to know each preset's real ctx or it silently truncates — the 4096-cap incident.
scripts.notes: Run via apply-model-config.sh.

scripts.name: make_models_workspace.py
scripts.what: Sets base_model_id=NULL on workspace models so OWUI overrides the base instead of skipping it.
scripts.why: Without it the router-alias workspace models don't appear correctly.
scripts.notes: Run via apply-model-config.sh.

scripts.name: patch_openai_model_names.py
scripts.what: Patches Open-WebUI's openai.py inside the container so /v1/models carries workspace display names.
scripts.why: docker compose up -d recreates the container and wipes the patch — this is why model names revert after recreates.
scripts.notes: Auto-run by apply-model-config.sh; must be re-applied after any container recreate.

scripts.name: script_panel.py (this panel)
scripts.what: The control panel itself — catalog server + UI + gated run API on 127.0.0.1:8770.
scripts.why: Meta entry so the panel can report its own health.

scripts.name: krill_status.sh
scripts.what: Status dashboard — service health, DEFCON level, paper P&L, recent audit tail, trade count.
scripts.why: One-glance ops check; runs unprivileged at reduced depth, sudo for audit log + supervisor socket.

scripts.name: funnel_check.sh
scripts.what: Weekly funnel digest — journalctl-only counts: catalysts, nano-filtered vs to-model per source, errors, denials, kraken_pairs deltas. Writes ~/.local/state/krill/funnel-<date>.md + desktop notification.
scripts.why: Anti-mothballing check-in; cron Thursdays 08:30. Prints the audit-pull + counterfactual steps when to-model traffic flows.

scripts.name: deploy.sh
scripts.what: Canonical production deploy — rsyncs src to /opt/krill_harvester (preserving audit.jsonl/state.db), rebuilds supervisor, reinstalls units, daemon-reload.
scripts.why: Idempotent; the only supported path to push repo code to the live daemon. Requires sudo.

scripts.name: verify_secops.sh
scripts.what: SecOps posture verifier — llama bind, secrets perms, egress, DEFCON isolation. Read-only; exits 0 on all HARD checks.
scripts.why: Run after host or config changes; sudo enables filesystem-perm checks.

scripts.name: pii_check.sh
scripts.what: PII scrubber — scans staged files against patterns + local allowlist before commit/push.
scripts.why: Pre-commit hook; run manually before pushing anything new. Strips emails, tailnet names, home paths, tokens.

scripts.name: rig-health-check.sh
scripts.what: 7-probe recovery-floor check: llama endpoint, sshd:52222, rocm, power cap, failed units, kernel errors, restic repo.
scripts.why: Phase-0 gate — if this isn't green, nothing above the recovery floor should be trusted. Read-only.

scripts.name: rig-invariant-check.sh
scripts.what: Reads ~/.config/rig/invariants.conf; verifies the rig is still the rig (llama, sshd, GPU clients, mounts, stale guards).
scripts.why: Runs post-mutation + every 15min via user timer; FAILs are journal-tagged rig-invariant.

scripts.name: guardrail-self-test.sh
scripts.what: 10-check self-test of the scaffold itself: deny fires, nested deny, snapshot-on-mutate, guard arm path, agent-sys confinement.
scripts.why: Guardrails get their own watchdog — proves the safety layer works, not just that it exists. Weekly timer.
scripts.confirm_text: Run the self-test? It writes/removes sacrificial test files under /etc/systemd and arms+disarms a guard timer.

scripts.name: rig-guard-status.sh
scripts.what: One-screen text view: armed revert timers, probation pending, promotions, recent snapshots, health tail.
scripts.why: CLI twin of the /trust console page. Read-only.

scripts.name: guarded-change.sh
scripts.what: snapshot → arm root revert timer → apply → verify → disarm|revert. The dead-man rollback mechanism.
scripts.why: Every mutation of protected state should flow through this. Not panel-runnable: takes args + sudo.
scripts.notes: Invoke from shell: guarded-change.sh --ttl 900 --verify '<cmd>' --apply '<cmd>' [--probation]. See ~/runbooks.

scripts.name: agent-deny-check.py
scripts.what: Devin PreToolUse hook enforcing ~/.config/rig/deny.conf on full command strings (catches bash -c nesting). Blocks journal-tag agent-deny.
scripts.why: Canonical denylist enforcement point; 24 incident-minted rules + compiled-in floor.
scripts.notes: Hook — invoked by Devin on every tool call; takes hook JSON on stdin.

scripts.name: agent-pre-mutate.py
scripts.what: Devin PreToolUse hook: scoped restic snapshot before writes to protected paths or inherent mutators (systemctl enable, apt install).
scripts.why: Nothing wrong is permanent — every protected mutation is preceded by a restorable snapshot. Fail-closed.
scripts.notes: Hook — invoked by Devin before mutating tool calls; logs to ~/.local/state/rig-guard/snapshots.log.

scripts.name: agent-promote.sh
scripts.what: Promote a probationary change to permanent — disarms its auto-revert timer and logs the promotion.
scripts.why: Phase-5 probation: unpromoted changes revert at 24h. Human decision point.
scripts.notes: Usage: agent-promote.sh <gid> — gids listed by rig-guard-status or /trust.

scripts.name: safe-config-edit.sh
scripts.what: guarded-change wrapper for single-file config edits: install new content + verify cmd + auto-revert.
scripts.why: Runbook primitive — shrinks what an agent has to compose for the common mutation.

scripts.name: gpu-job-audit.sh
scripts.what: Scans timers + ~/scripts for GPU-touching jobs bypassing the gpu-lane acquire/release fencing.
scripts.why: Lane-rule tripwire; exits nonzero on violations. Run after adding any scheduled GPU job.
